kaito.sourceWork: KAITO original Japanese VOCALOID voicebank (2006), original package avatar; Cantarella vocal role (2008)
kaito.appearance: Male illustrated virtual singer with dark-blue slightly flared short hair, long blue scarf, white long coat with blue edging and yellow sleeve accent, dark inner shirt and trousers, simple dark shoes, original small black headset microphone; no official numerical age asserted and no V3 costume substitution
kaito.weapon: Original headset microphone and a held stage microphone for a performance gesture, never a weapon
kaito.pose: Sing a short Cantarella vocal phrase and coordinate the musical cue with a free hand; no poison, materialized lyrics, projectile, magic, healing or invented damaging voice
kaito.name: Cantarella — voix de KAITO

oracle_matrix.sourceWork: The Matrix feature film (1999), Gloria Foster as the Oracle in the first kitchen consultation
oracle_matrix.appearance: Older Black woman with short dark curled hair, forest-green blouse/dress and burnt-orange kitchen apron, quiet gold earrings; conservative low dark shoes and the unseen lower hem are explicit full-body drawing adaptations rather than verified film costume details; not Mary Alice or later appearances
oracle_matrix.weapon: No weapon; a small cookie may be held as the kitchen consultation prop, never thrown as an attack
oracle_matrix.pose: Listen, offer a quiet spoken observation, and extend a small cookie as a reassuring consultation gesture; bounded ally advice only, no physical prophecy, telekinesis, healing or magic projectile
oracle_matrix.secondaryName: Offrir le conseil de la cuisine
oracle_matrix.name: Le conseil de l’Oracle

sourceNotes.kaito: Original2006 official thumbnail downloaded and actually opened with view_image; headset/scarf/blue-white-yellow outfit confirmed. Official numerical age is not published. Cantarella2008 is a distinct later vocal association, not claimed2006 release song.
sourceNotes.oracle_matrix: Two independently read articles confirm green dress and orange apron. Image URLs failed direct download403. No claim to have viewed those film pixels. Lower hem/shoes explicitly adapted conservatively; no global fidelity certification.
